headline: Result Update

highlights: Positives: • Online business reported healthy growth of 26% yoy with margin expansion. • Focus on expanding in South India; investments in tech and AI continue. • Offline center count increased to 370 in 2Q. • We model CAGR of 30% in online revenue and 22% in offline revenue over FY26-29E. • We model revenue CAGR of 26% over FY26-29E.
Negatives: • Offline revenue growth of 10% was impacted by delay in NEET batches.
